definitions.explanation: A diagram or figure used to visually explain a concept, process, structure, or procedure.

examples.japanese: {説明図|せつめいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please look at the explanatory diagram.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取扱|とりあつかい}{説明書|せつめいしょ}→取扱説明書：10278_toriatsukaisetsumeisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{説明図|せつめいず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: There is an explanatory diagram in the instruction manual.

examples.japanese: ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{説明図|せつめいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすく⟦{解説|かいせつ}した→解説する：17850_kaisetsusuru⟧。
examples.english: A complex mechanism was explained clearly using an explanatory diagram.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧ (explanation) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (diagram; figure). Used in technical writing, manuals, textbooks, and presentations to refer to visual aids that clarify information.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {説明図|せつめいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refer to the explanatory diagram
- {説明図|せつめいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to create an explanatory diagram
- {説明図|せつめいず}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with explanatory diagrams

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{図解|ずかい}→図解：18235_zukai⟧: illustrated explanation — emphasizes the act of explaining through diagrams
- ⟦{模式図|もしきず}→模式図：27660_moshikizu⟧: schematic diagram — a simplified, abstract representation
- ⟦イラスト→イラスト：10717_irasuto⟧: illustration — broader term, includes decorative art as well as explanatory graphics
